text: Jordan spent time practicing "Fast Car" for an open mic at The Lantern that Mika signed them up for without much warning—a typical move on her part that Jordan half-resents and half-appreciates, since it pushes them to do things they'd otherwise avoid. After a shaky start, the practice session clicked by the third and fifth run-throughs, made even more memorable by Pepper the cat "singing" along during a quiet verse, which had Jordan laughing. The overall mood was joyful and grounding, leaving Jordan resolved to make music a more regular part of life.
